title: Frame30 Universal Verification Mould (DICE) Stage 2.3: Trusted Root-of-Trust, Conjunctive Verification & Attestation Integrity
objective: Eliminate circular-trust vulnerabilities in Stage 2.2 by establishing an independent trusted root-of-trust, conjunctive multi-method execution (DISP_PASS iff forall m in Methods(o): VerifiedPASS(m)), strict clean-tree candidate snapshotting (zero host .git, .env, or credential exposure), authoritative key-managed DSSE attestation signing with revocation and role authorization, fail-closed execution disposition semantics (distinguishing PASS, FAIL, and BLOCKED), and a 14-scenario adversarial qualification matrix.
merchant_or_user_outcome: Guarantees that untrusted candidate code cannot compromise or weaken the verification authority evaluating it, ensuring mathematical certainty in build qualification, zero secret leakage, and cryptographic non-repudiation of verification evidence.
problem_and_evidence: Stage 2.2 audits revealed circular-trust vulnerabilities: (1) authoritative verification policy and scripts were loaded from the candidate checkout rather than an independent trusted root, (2) bootstrap evaluated only obDef.methods[0] rather than conjunctively verifying all declared methods, (3) sandbox mounted host repo checkout and exposed host .git to scope guard rather than isolating a clean candidate tree snapshot, (4) attestation used ephemeral generateTestKeypair() rather than authoritative role-authorized key resolution and revocation checking, (5) execution disposition semantics needed clean separation between worker failure and sandbox setup/timeout blockages.
behavioral_requirements: 1. Independent trusted root: Authoritative verification policies, schemas, registries, and evaluator logic derive from an authenticated trusted reference ref/SHA.
2. Conjunctive multi-method execution: DISP_PASS(o) holds iff every declared method m in Methods(o) achieves independently verified PASS.
3. Clean candidate tree snapshot: Isolated snapshot extracted via git archive from candidateTree; raw host .git, .env, and home dirs are never mounted in sandbox.
4. Scope guard isolation: Scope guard receives pre-computed diff manifest inside container; maskGit is enabled across all sandboxed obligations.
5. Authoritative signing authority: Attestation signing requires active, non-revoked key with role 'dice-attestation-signer'; unattested fallback on absent/invalid key.
6. Distinct execution dispositions: Cleanly differentiates PASS, FAIL, and BLOCKED (sandbox launch failure, namespace errors, and timeouts fail closed as BLOCKED).
forbidden_behaviors: 1. Loading authoritative verification policy solely from untrusted candidate checkout.
2. Omitting or ignoring non-zero methods in multi-method obligations (const method = obDef.methods[0]).
3. Mounting raw host .git or working directory containing uncommitted secrets into the sandbox.
4. Authoritative attestation signing using ephemeral in-memory test keys.
5. Masking sandbox setup failure or timeout as candidate failure or pass.
